title: How Many Rectangles in the Staircase? | AMC 8-Style Level 5
description:
Fifteen little squares stacked like stairs, and lots of kids say there are 15 rectangles. There are way more! Vantee counts them two ways: sorting by height, then the speedy corner trick that turns it into a times table. Then try a taller staircase yourself.
